method: Independent local automatic transcription; not a human listening pass

chapters.expected: Across Wrocław, bronze dwarves share poses and props. Given a photograph, which individual statue are we looking at? Meet Doppeldwarf-306.
chapters.transcribed: Across Rotswaffe, bronze dwarves share poses and props. Given a photograph which individual statue are we looking at, Meet Doppledworth 306.

chapters.expected: A frozen vision model turns each image into a vector: a numerical visual description. Cosine similarity compares these vectors. Similar directions suggest similar appearance; they do not prove identity. We rank each statue by its best reference photograph, without fine-tuning the model.
chapters.transcribed: A frozen vision model turns each image into a vector, a numerical visual description. Cosine similarity compares these vectors. Similar directions suggest similar appearance. They do not prove identity. We rank each statue by its best reference photograph without fine-tuning the model.

chapters.expected: Now add more candidates. Do lookalikes overwhelm retrieval? Instead of reporting one accuracy number, we repeatedly sample larger candidate pools, always keeping the correct statue. DINOv2's accuracy falls slowly; CLIP's falls faster. The curve is the result.
chapters.transcribed: Now add more candidates. Do lookalikes overwhelm retrieval. Instead of reporting one accuracy number, we repeatedly sample larger candidate pools, always keeping the correct statue. Dino V2's accuracy falls slowly. Clips falls faster. The curve is the result.

chapters.expected: Surely location solves this? But nearby lookalikes survive a hard geographic filter. In simulation, a soft distance bonus works better. Across 294 placed statues, DINOv2 rises from 93.4 to 98.7 percent for users twenty-five metres away.
chapters.transcribed: Surely location solves this, but nearby look-alike survive a hard geographic filter. In simulation, a soft distance bonus works better. Across 294 place statues, Dino V2 rises from 93.4 to 98.7% for users 25 meters away.

chapters.expected: A new photographer brings different viewpoints, backgrounds, and lighting. Accuracy drops; fewer reference photographs also contribute. LoFTR matches local details across photographs. Geometric consistency adds evidence to visual similarity, moving a better match up the shortlist.
chapters.transcribed: A new photographer brings different viewpoints, backgrounds, and lighting. Accuracy drops, fewer reference photographs also contribute. Laughter matches local details across photographs. Geometric consistency adds evidence to visual similarity, moving a better match up the shortlist.

chapters.expected: Finally, high similarity need not mean a known statue. Comparing the best two candidates exposes ambiguity. This margin reduces false acceptance in the research; the browser demo uses a separately measured close-call hint.
